issue.title: Bug: PTF sflow test fails with a KeyError when no packets are sent

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

When there is an issue with the sflow on the dut and zero sflow packets are sent, the PTF test fails with a KeyError in `analyze_flow_sample()`:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/b74ad71f08c0f9c4ff98b1493fb2f981b5fed10e/ansible/roles/test/files/ptftests/py3/sflow_test.py#L234
```
ATTENTION: SOME TESTS DID NOT PASS!!!

The following tests errored:
SflowTest

******************************************stderr =
/root/env-python3/lib/python3.11/site-packages/scapy/layers/ipsec.py:512: CryptographyDeprecationWarning: TripleDES has been moved to cryptography.hazmat.decrepit.ciphers.algorithms.TripleDES and will be removed from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.algorithms in 48.0.0.
  cipher=algorithms.TripleDES,
/root/env-python3/lib/python3.11/site-packages/scapy/layers/ipsec.py:516: CryptographyDeprecationWarning: TripleDES has been moved to cryptography.hazmat.decrepit.ciphers.algorithms.TripleDES and will be removed from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.algorithms in 48.0.0.
  cipher=algorithms.TripleDES,
sflow_test.SflowTest ... ERROR

======================================================================
ERROR: sflow_test.SflowTest
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/root/ptftests/py3/sflow_test.py", line 381, in runTest
    self.packet_analyzer(self.collector0_samples,
  File "/root/ptftests/py3/sflow_test.py", line 236, in packet_analyzer
    self.analyze_flow_sample(data, collector)
  File "/root/ptftests/py3/sflow_test.py", line 275, in analyze_flow_sample
    data['flow_port_count'])
    ~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
KeyError: 'flow_port_count'

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Ran 1 test in 45.140s

FAILED (errors=1)
```
The test should fail cleanly at this point, instead of failing due to an uninitialized variable.

### Steps to Reproduce

* Pause the test right before running the PTF test
* Change the sample rate to something very large for all configured interfaces (`sudo config sflow interface sample-rate Ethernet448 8388608`
* Continue the test, and you should see the PTF test fail with `KeyError: 'flow_port_count'`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected:
The test fails with some reasonable error message, like `No sflow sample packets collected`

Actual:
The test fails with `KeyError: 'flow_port_count'`

resolution.title: Issue 22656: Check for no packets received in sflow PTF test
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:

Currently the test will fail with a KeyError somewhere random, because it assumes it will always get at least one packet. But if the test is badly failing, that might not be true. Better to have a clear error and failure point.

Fixes #22656
